# Tour My Holiday

> > Tour My Holiday specializes in Himalayan trekking adventures and spiritual tourism across Uttarakhand, featuring Chopta, Tungnath Temple, Chandrashila summit, Valley of Flowers, and cultural experiences throughout the Garhwal Himalayas.

Tour My Holiday offers curated tour packages and comprehensive travel guides for trekking, pilgrimage, and adventure tourism in the Indian Himalayas. The platform focuses on Uttarakhand destinations including sacred temples, alpine meadows, UNESCO sites, and seasonal experiences with detailed itineraries from major cities like Delhi and Rishikesh.

## Key Topics

- Chopta trekking and camping
- Tungnath Temple (highest Shiva temple)
- Chandrashila summit trek
- Valley of Flowers UNESCO site
- Garhwal Himalayas expeditions
- Uttarakhand spiritual tourism
- Himalayan biodiversity and flora
- Auli skiing and winter sports
- Panch Kedar pilgrimage circuit
- Delhi to Uttarakhand packages
- Seasonal trek planning (monsoon, winter, spring)
- Hemkund Sahib pilgrimage
- Dayara Bugyal meadows
- Rishikesh adventure base
- Cultural festivals (Holi, Christmas in hills)
